gaps.statement: No HZT empirical inference bundle is bound with versioned data vector, covariance, selection function and nuisance definitions for the declared observational claims.

gaps.statement: Prospective RAR, expansion, growth, lensing and GW channels lack simultaneous released parent-derived amplitudes/spectra/parameter dependence and operational falsification thresholds.
gaps.closure_condition: For each claimed channel: released parent map, observable definition, implementation, uncertainties/data provenance where empirical, and explicit rejection criterion.
